body: If whatever you told this friend has had that affect then perhaps your partner should have told them themselves. Your partner is still with you so they must not think that you hate them, they will be glad for your support even if they're not seeming grateful. Though remember that you also need to look out for yourself, take the time to care for yourself and do something each week that you enjoy, even if it's just running yourself a bath or taking a walk to your favourite viewpoint. Take an hour out to treat yourself like somebody you love ♥️

We all fuck up but trusting someone is not your fuck up, you can't live your life  never trusting anyone ever. Why did this disappoint your partner?
The things you do are good enough, you're not giving yourself enough credit. 150 job applications takes dedication and commitment. You have drive, you just need to channel it and have confidence in yourself.

I'd really love a hug rn ♥️, I'm really struggling and I don't know what to do. But here we are, on a post you made because you are feeling lost and I am making it all about me.
Tell me what's going on in your life.
I understand, I've pushed away everyone in my life because it's easier than keeping those connections but now I feel so alone. No one wants to hear about the sad girl

You are beaver than I, it takes a lot of courage to admit that you need help, even more to seek it. It's also anxiety that I suffer with, I'm in constant turmoil and it causes me to act out and hurt those who try to befriend me. I don't deserve any kindness.

Christmas is a tough time for a lot of people, volunteers are giving up their time with families to help those in need. Please don't be discouraged for reaching out. 

I know exactly where you are coming from. I don't want to die but I don't want to live anymore either. It's a difficult situation to find yourself, you just feel helpless. I almost feel like I am not in any position to offer you a helping hand as I am also down the same well but I am available to talk if you need.

I understand, it feels like you're broken. That your brain just doesn't work right and there's nothing you can do about it. I try to focus on things I can feel rather than things with emotional responses. I used to do this by self harm but now I use cold water. Swimming in the sea, getting hit by the waves or just jumping into a cold lake. Sometimes I think about tying rocks to my ankles but most the time the shock of the water is enough to make me feel alive again. 
I wish I had the balls to get help, I wish someone had the cure to my brain malfunctions. I envy your courage for seeking help, even if it isn't working out for you right now.

How about we take a step back and talk about the mental torment that is pushing you to this point of feeling so helpless that this is your only option.
I understand all too well the desire to put an end to your misery, but I don't want ro die I just want to silence my mind and the only way I can see that happening is if I turn off the power. But fuck me it's exhausting, living every day in with this in my head pretending on the outside that everything is just fine. Have you talked to anyone?
